About Repair Mode
Use me if your Play Integrity verdict suddenly starts failing after working correctly for some time, or if the Key Attestation app reports your device's bootloader as unlocked even though your keybox is valid. This action performs an advanced attestation reinitialization sequence designed to restore consistency across the integrity verification pipeline.
